experiment_name: Isolating whether hybrid-PPO's fixed BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE carve-out causes a POLICY_ONLY strength loss

algorithm_config.baseline_arm: focus seat POLICY_ONLY (build_local_policy_only), other 3 seats POLICY_ONLY
algorithm_config.candidate_arm: focus seat HYBRID_COMPAT (build_local_hybrid_compat_policy, diagnostic-only), other 3 seats POLICY_ONLY
algorithm_config.seat_rotation: 20 DEV seeds x 4 focus seats = 80 games per arm, same seed + same focus seat paired
algorithm_config.isolation_integrity_check_method: play_local_game's shadow_policy hook: a fresh POLICY_ONLY instance queried on the identical pre-step state as every HYBRID_COMPAT focus-seat decision, in every one of the 80 candidate games; script raises and refuses to report any stat if any decision HYBRID_COMPAT did not flag as a BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE opportunity produced a different action than plain POLICY_ONLY on that same state

bootstrap_provenance_audit.interpretation: Local checkpoint SHA does NOT match TRAINING_RESULTS.md's documented SHA for this filename (expected: experiment 007 generated its OWN 1-game stand-in checkpoint at this exact path purely to satisfy MonopolyZeroNet.load_ppo_actor's format/metadata check, never downloaded or reproduced upstream's full training run). It DOES match experiment 007's own logged SHA, confirming this is that exact, previously-documented artifact, not a silently-changed one. The payload's own hybrid/games_trained/step_count fields are the only source of truth used for 'how trained' it is - no broader 'untrained weights' claim is made beyond them. Independently: the statically-verified fixed_action_mask lines mean BUY_PROPERTY's and ACCEPT_TRADE's actor output rows never received a gradient update under the reference's own PPOAgent in hybrid mode (hybrid=True here), regardless of games trained - those two rows are at whatever random initialization ActorNetwork's final nn.Linear started at, both in this checkpoint and after load_ppo_actor's full (ungated) copy into baseline_pretraining.pt.

result: Isolation integrity check PASSED (0 violations across all 80 candidate games' 96,629 non-forced focus-seat decisions): every decision HYBRID_COMPAT did not flag as a BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE opportunity produced an action identical to plain POLICY_ONLY on the same state, confirming BASELINE and CANDIDATE are isolated to exactly that carve-out. Bootstrap provenance: baseline_pretraining.pt's actor was copied in full (verified: load_ppo_actor's actor.load_state_dict(payload['actor']) line, no gating carried over) from a locally-generated (experiment 007), 1-game/598-step PPO-hybrid checkpoint (hybrid=True verified from the checkpoint's own payload at runtime; its SHA matches experiment 007's log, not TRAINING_RESULTS.md's documented upstream artifact of the same filename - confirmed these are two different checkpoints sharing only a filename) whose BUY_PROPERTY/ACCEPT_TRADE action-head rows were statically confirmed (fixed_action_mask lines grepped verbatim from the pinned reference source) to be permanently excluded from every PPO gradient update - i.e. at random initialization, not merely lightly trained; no broader 'untrained weights' claim is made beyond this. At the 8,173 opportunity decisions found (8.46% of all 96,629 non-forced focus-seat decisions: 2,616 BUY_PROPERTY-legal, 5,557 genuine incoming-trade-response), plain POLICY_ONLY NEVER once chose BUY_PROPERTY or ACCEPT_TRADE (0/2616, 0/5557 - chosen_action_frequency 0.0 for both), despite assigning them non-trivial mean probability (7.9% buy, 10.7% accept): the untrained logits are competitive but apparently never win the legal-set argmax against this checkpoint's heavily-trained alternatives at these decisions, so POLICY_ONLY's systematic failure mode here is 'never buy property, never accept a trade', not random erratic picks. This produced a large, statistically significant strength difference in the clean 20-seed x 4-seat paired screen (80 games/arm, zero fixed opponents, zero fallback-contamination risk): CANDIDATE (HYBRID_COMPAT) won 37/80 (46.25%, Wilson [0.357,0.571]) vs. BASELINE (plain POLICY_ONLY) 20/80 (25.0%, Wilson [0.168,0.355]). Both PRIMARY seed-block statistics agree and exclude zero: the paired randomization test's observed mean win-rate diff is +0.2125 (p=0.000122, exact enumeration over 2^20 sign patterns), and the seed-block bootstrap's win-rate-diff 95% CI is [0.1375, 0.2875] (net-worth diff +2093.09, 95% CI [1020.47, 3272.17]). Secondary seat-level McNemar (b=21, c=4, p=0.00091) is directionally consistent but not relied on alone (clustered seats - see evaluation_protocol.py's docstring). Bankruptcy rate fell from 41.25% (baseline) to 16.25% (candidate); round-cap rate rose from 75% to 85% (fewer eliminations, longer competitive games). No promotion/GO-KILL verdict is computed by this script - these numbers are for a human to read and decide the next step.
notes: policy_only_at_buy_opportunities/policy_only_at_trade_opportunities are measured over the SAME 8,173 opportunity decisions the CANDIDATE arm's HYBRID_COMPAT focus seat actually visited (its own trajectory), not an independent BASELINE-arm sample - BASELINE and CANDIDATE trajectories diverge after the first intervention in a given game, so these frequencies describe what POLICY_ONLY would have chosen along HYBRID_COMPAT's path, not literally within the BASELINE arm's own played games. This does not affect the isolation integrity check (which only compares actions on states both policies genuinely visited) or the paired win-rate/net-worth statistics (which compare each arm's own actually-played games). The 300 candidate_set_narrowed_neural_pick decisions are almost entirely BUY_PROPERTY-declined-by-rule cases (2,616 buy opportunities - 2,316 bought = 300 declined-and-narrowed; the 0 trade_opportunity_but_no_pending_found means no ACCEPT_TRADE-legal-without-pending edge case ever fired).
